WITH w AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval AS status, sc.scancount AS scancount, CAST(sc.gbsize AS REAL) / sc.spanmin AS ratio
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND s.healtheval IS NOT NULL
),
g AS (
  SELECT status, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM w
  GROUP BY status
)
SELECT status, total_scans, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM g) AS deviation_from_mean
FROM g
WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM g) IS NOT NULL
